The '''Tusken March''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG" />
[[File:TuskenMarchGrave.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A small graveyard in the Tusken March, accompanied by a tree.]]
Largely inhabited by the planet's native [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]], the region was the location of [[Fort Tusken/Legends|Fort Tusken]].<ref name="SWG" /> The [[Tusken Relic Cave|Tusken relic cave]] was also situated a relatively close distance away from the Tusken March.<ref name="SWG:TR" /> The Tusken March also contained other curiosities, such as [[Tombstone|graveyards]], the [[Skeleton/Legends|skeletal]] remains of at least one [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]], ruins, and other scattered remnants of habitation.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tusken March appeared as a designated planetary region in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
